the same problem. You don't say Afro-Cuban just to use the name (inaudible). You like to know (inaudible). And if you didn't know (inaudible) you lost. And they feel that really you just -- is on the bongos. The rhythm go and the part and the (inaudible) bass player. You've got to be able to know how to (inaudible) how to write your name in that particular number, in that particular (inaudible), and none of them ever learned that.
